title.help: Short project title in business words.

customer_name.help: Use the customer placeholder exactly as it appears in the notes.

background.help: 2 to 4 sentences: who the customer is and why this project exists.

objectives.help: 3 to 5 business outcomes. No technology names unless the customer asked for them.

scope_in.help: What is included, in business terms.

deliverables.help: Documents, environments or services handed over.

phases.help: Phases in order. Duration as stated in the notes, otherwise 'To be confirmed'.

assumptions.help: Things assumed because the notes were silent or unclear.

customer_responsibilities.help: What the customer must provide or decide.

price_summary.help: Only figures stated in the notes. Otherwise: 'To be confirmed after the open items are answered.'

open_questions.help: impact is one of: price, scope, schedule, design, risk.

forbidden_patterns.name: resource count such as '2 x EC2'
